boundary: This is a transparent founder decision heuristic, not a valuation, patentability opinion, customer commitment, or performance guarantee.

lanes.name: ProofLock Opportunity Operations
lanes.offer: Continuously find, qualify, assemble, preflight, and receipt funding opportunities while keeping final certifications and submissions human-controlled.

evidence_paths.claim_scope: A local healthcare opportunity discovery and ranking implementation exists; this does not prove current source coverage or buyer eligibility.
A local source-to-website feed builder exists; this does not prove that any displayed record is current or eligible.
A local fail-closed readiness audit implementation exists; only its current outputs can describe a package state.
A local deadline-control implementation exists; code presence is not a current deadline receipt.
The deadline command board was rebuilt recently enough for internal triage; every official source and portal gate still requires action-time verification.
A buyer-facing workflow demonstration exists; it is not a production deployment, customer acceptance receipt, or measured outcome.

lanes.first_validation: Run a paid 30-day design-partner pilot against the buyer's current grant workflow and lock the baseline before automation begins.
lanes.recurring_model: Per-organization subscription with controlled seats, opportunity monitoring, evidence storage, and an optional managed preflight tier.
blocked_claims: realized savings before a buyer baseline is measured

lanes.name: ProofLock Evidence Router API
lanes.offer: Select a bounded model or workflow route, abstain when gates fail, and emit a replayable decision receipt with source and policy provenance.

evidence_paths.claim_scope: A historical routing implementation exists; its current feature construction is not cleared for prospective superiority claims.
A claim-bounded commercial packaging implementation exists; it does not establish demand, pricing acceptance, or revenue.
A historical exploratory router evaluation exists; the known full-series feature leakage blocks prospective performance claims.
A historical stacker evaluation receipt exists; it is bounded to its recorded design and is not external validation.

lanes.first_validation: Rebuild router features from training windows only, add deterministic abstention, and evaluate prospectively against the best fixed family and a declared oracle boundary.
lanes.recurring_model: Usage-priced API plus enterprise policy packs and retained evidence storage.
blocked_claims: leakage-free performance until the train-only rerun passes

lanes.name: Energy Forecast Validation Service
lanes.offer: Buyer-authorized forecast replay and evidence receipts for grid, facility, and energy-planning decisions.

evidence_paths.claim_scope: A reproducibility-packet builder exists; its presence does not prove independent reproduction.
An economic-conversion packet builder exists; realized savings remain blocked without buyer-authorized operational inputs.
The prospective EIA status was refreshed recently; its own settlement and promotion gates control any performance language.
A bounded independent-review handoff exists; its recorded completion flags govern independent-validation claims.
A human-readable reproduction handoff exists; document presence does not prove evaluator completion or acceptance.

lanes.first_validation: Complete the preregistered prospective sample gates, obtain an independent reproduction receipt, and secure one operator-approved dataset, incumbent baseline, holdout policy, and economic conversion before discussing performance or dollar value.
lanes.recurring_model: Monitoring and model-governance subscription after a scoped validation engagement.
blocked_claims: field validation without an operator receipt

lanes.name: LumaScout A&R Intelligence

evidence_paths.claim_scope: A LumaScout dashboard implementation exists; it does not prove current licensed data coverage or predictive validity.

A claim-bounded commercialization map exists; it is planning evidence, not market validation.

lanes.recurring_model: A&R team subscription with watchlists, alerts, and portfolio outcome tracking.

evidence_paths.claim_scope: A paper-research dashboard exists; it is not live trading authorization, custody evidence, or a profitability receipt.
